name: Iran nuclear programme
summary: No IAEA access; Iran ties nuclear talks to its war terms as US threatens a nuclear site
state: The IAEA has had no access to key Iranian sites and reported Iran to the UN Security Council in October (Arms Control Association). A senior Iranian official said on 3–4 Nov that nuclear talks can start only once Iran's conditions are met (SBS). Trump has named a suspected nuclear complex at Pickaxe Mountain as a remaining target (CBS); US strikes on 2 Nov hit Qeshm Island, not nuclear sites.
for_you: No direct effect on the public; strikes on nuclear sites would raise regional and energy-market risk.
rubric_hit: Inspector access curtailed and credible strike threats = Watch

sources.title: Arms Control Association — IAEA reports Iran to UN Security Council

why: A nuclear-armed Iran — or strikes to prevent one — could ignite the Gulf and send oil far higher.
drivers: Enrichment levels, IAEA access, Israeli/US military posture, snapback sanctions, talks.

rubric.alert: Strikes on nuclear sites, NPT withdrawal, or evidence of weaponisation.
rubric.watch: Enrichment at ≥ 60% or inspector access curtailed, or credible strike threats.
rubric.normal: IAEA access and active diplomacy; no escalation.
